title: Conditional κ = 0.001530327580902932: kernel92 with native-body frame lifts
body:
This composes [#533](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/533)'s 92-pivot supplier with [#534](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/534)'s native-body frame assignment. The complete emitted construction certifies **conditional κ = 0.001530327580902932**, exactly `382581895225733/250000000000000000`: **0.40150% above #533** and **0.42647% above the pinned #534 snapshot**.

The constructor first rebuilds #531's raw 504-helper factory and #533's exact rational kernel selection. It matches the native A/B scalar operations against #534's frozen word and transfers their **662 frame lifts**. The new kernel prefix, helper entrances, target levels, center cuts and cleanup stay fixed. Every transferred frame contains its raw constructor frame and every register chain is checked independently. This is a proved compatibility of the actual words; the source PR exponent gains are not added.

The local profile becomes `{1:2174,2:496,3:357,4:226,5:139,6:56,7:8}`. Its rank mass remains 6,228. The 164 width-eight and 340 width-nine helpers, 36,288 whole-owner roles, 7,536 idle remainders, 7,168 live families and 7,682 physical families are unchanged from #533. The final global profile is:

```text
{1:156528,2:35712,3:28376,4:16272,5:13592,6:4032,7:944,48:912}
```

Both exact moment engines accept `b = 0.001532673072778713292743` and reject the next 10^-24 grid point. The complex supplier remains binding against the unchanged #493 bit rate `0.001565442026981656908596`. Six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities give the displayed κ. The fresh prefix is 225 bits within the 512-bit charge, and the global rank deficit remains 2,560.

**Concurrent work:** [#536](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/536) independently publishes the same composition, local profile and rate. This PR retains its separately rebuilt cross-platform receipts and transfer controls. [#535](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/535) now reports the stronger conditional κ `0.001584931111785787`; this PR is below that newer claim. The #534 comparison above uses pinned commit `768183a86a8c961621702547042579eb9f376c2c`, before its later frame-search update.

## Reproduction and validation

```sh
python -B research/direct504-kernel92-lifts/verify.py /tmp/direct504-kernel92-lifts-check
```

Standard library only, offline, with assertions enabled and a fresh output directory. No optimizer runs. The verifier rebuilds the fixed supplier, independently checks the transfer, replays both 728-column local orientations, freshly lowers all **2,924 local phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters**, verifies seven normalized residual wrappers, re-emits the actual whole-owner program, recounts its complete finite invoice and runs the exact exponent assembly.

Controls reject 92 omitted kernel corrections, 13 local corruptions, five wrapper corruptions, seven owner/controller corruptions, four frame-transfer corruptions and four outer corruptions. Optimized Python, missing owner data and modified source reject before output creation. Portable gzip output pins level nine, mtime zero and OS byte 255; no mathematical tolerance is introduced.

`proof/CONSTRUCTION.md`, `EXPECTED.json`, `SOURCES.json` and `MANIFEST.json` bind the construction. The final source passed on Linux/Python 3.11 and macOS/Python 3.14, with matching canonical-word, emitted-program and local-phase hashes. Receipts are in `research/direct504-kernel92-lifts-validation/`. Dedicated CI runs Python 3.11 and 3.14; remote CI is pending at submission.

## Sources and scope

- **#534**, rohanarun with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), `768183a86a8c961621702547042579eb9f376c2c`: the selected frame assignment and independent monotone-lift checker. The new frame optimization is credited to that work.
- **#533**, chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance, `ae63ec50f99862efeda351e7687b087744423521`: the 92-pivot selection, unchanged owner map and full-phase reconstruction framework. Its later merge head `66b00aeaabb6b4b0545b65685c1ea78f157a8d5e` preserves the proof package bytes.
- **#531**, icekylinx with GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI Codex assistance, `e07a8a3f9f79c22113398a0c5dbbc7601f489b3e`: direct delivery, same-partition source frontier, raw 504-helper factory, gauge baseline, frame-coalescing argument, and supplier/owner/invoice checkers. Its entire package is preserved under `vendor/pr531`.
- **#523**, icekylinx: 112-port controller/restriction ancestry. **#514**, Dugongue, and **#507**, eumemic: packet and partial-own ancestry. **#505**, Dugongue: asynchronous scheduling. **#417/#433/#435/#434/#440/#484** and preserved notices: exact response kernels and gauges, including DreamingOfClouds's implementation with Claude Opus 5.5 assistance. **#493**, eumemic: unchanged bit operator.
- **#529** and its attributed #523 reference: independent omitted-correction checker and full local-phase driver. **#425/#433/#370/#361/#315** and credited predecessors: geometry, phases, exact moments and analytic framework.

The transfer, compatibility controls and combined reconstruction were prepared for chafreaky with **OpenAI Codex** assistance. All inherited notices and licenses remain intact.

The unchanged data-controller/data-phase certificate and #493 physical bit operator remain pinned dependencies; the bit histogram is repriced but its operator is not cold-rebuilt here. All local phases are fresh. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization, normalized Lemma A, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer interfaces remain conditional. No new Lean, unrestricted optimality, κ = 1 or unconditional multiplication claim is made.
